blocks.html: Robinsons Las Piñas brings the timeless magic of the holidays to life with the first-ever in-mall staging of the Manila C.O.D Christmas on Display, a beloved Filipino Christmas tradition now lighting up the South.

In partnership with Rosario Animated Display, the iconic Manila C.O.D Christmas on Display—a cherished tradition for over 71 years—returns to enchant a new generation with its dazzling lights, moving figures, and heartwarming storytelling. Originally staged in Quezon City, this year’s display finds a new home at Robinsons Las Piñas, allowing more families in the South to experience the joy, nostalgia, and togetherness that C.O.D. has long represented.

This year’s theme, “The Birth of Jesus Christ: A Christmas Story,” highlights the true essence of the season—faith, hope, joy, and giving—while bringing the nativity story to life through captivating animatronics and festive lights.

“We are happy to partner with Rosario Animated Display, Inc. in bringing this well-cherished Filipino Christmas tradition to Robinsons Las Piñas,” said Joel Lumanlan, Vice President for Operations and Marketing at Robinsons Malls. “Through this collaboration, we hope to preserve a meaningful piece of our cultural heritage while giving a new generation of families a chance to experience the magic and nostalgia of the Manila C.O.D. firsthand.”

The C.O.D. officially launched last October 15 and will run until January. From October to November, shows are held every hour from 2:00 PM to 8:00 PM, and from December to January, the display runs from 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM. Special seated viewings for senior citizens are available nightly from 5:00 PM to 8:00 PM.

By hosting the Manila C.O.D Christmas on Display., Robinsons Las Piñas helps preserve a treasured cultural legacy and makes it more accessible to families in the South. Beyond shopping and dining, Robinsons Malls continues to be a place where people come together to celebrate, connect, and create lasting memories.
Don’t miss the first-ever in-mall Manila C.O.D Christmas on Display at Robinsons Las Piñas — where tradition meets today’s holiday cheer!
For more updates on upcoming holiday events, follow Robinsons Malls on social media, download the Rmalls+ App, or visit www.robinsonsmalls.com.
